name: btn-hover-multiple

frames.best_why: The button is fully lifted with all three offset shadow pills fanned out and the cursor sits away from it.

tagline: Hover lifts a blue pill off a stack of offset blue copies.
summary: A blue Contact me pill that sits alone until hovered. Then it shifts up and left while three progressively paler copies fan out below and to its right, like a stack of cards.
appearance: A pill-shaped button filled with a navy-to-blue gradient and outlined in brighter blue, with white Contact me text. At rest one pill stands alone; hovered, three paler blue copies step out to its lower right.
behaviour: On hover the button slides up and left over a third of a second while three rounded shadow layers in deepening blues fan out to the lower right underneath. Moving off collapses the stack and returns the pill to centre.
search_phrases: button that shifts up and left on hover
use_when: A contact or primary action button needs extra presence and a tactile hover without adding imagery.
avoid_when: The blue palette is fixed in the class names, and the offset stack needs free space to the right and below.
customise: The label, gradient, border and shadow shades are hardcoded class names; it accepts no props and needs a file edit to change.
weight_why: One button and three CSS box shadows, with no JavaScript.

a11y.note: Real button text and a native focus ring help, but the stacked-shadow reveal only fires on hover, never on keyboard focus.

polish_why: A crisp stacked-paper illusion with a simple, smooth hover and nothing out of place.
